LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossHuge.stages.0.label: Huge forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossHuge.stages.0.description: Over ten thousand lost on forex. The bookkeeper checked three times; the number was patient and did not change.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossHuge.stages.1.label: Huge forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossHuge.stages.1.description: Another ten thousand gone. Someone suggested cutting the terminal up for flower pots. Nobody laughed.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossHuge.stages.2.label: Huge forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossHuge.stages.2.description: Another five-figure hole in the trading account. Everyone turned in early tonight; the lights went out two hours sooner than usual.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossBig.stages.0.label: Major forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossBig.stages.0.description: Several thousand gone on forex, close to ten. That money would have bought the whole colony a hundred simple meals.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossBig.stages.1.label: Major forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossBig.stages.1.description: Another near-five-figure loss. Someone asked the trader about credit. The trader looked away.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossBig.stages.2.label: Major forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossBig.stages.2.description: This round cost nearly ten thousand. Nobody raised it at the meeting; the chairs scraped very neatly on the way out.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossMedium.stages.0.label: Moderate forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossMedium.stages.0.descripti: A few thousand lost on forex. The numbers on screen barely moved, but the canteen went vegetarian first.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossMedium.stages.1.label: Moderate forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossMedium.stages.1.descripti: Another thousand or so down. Nobody looks toward the terminal anymore.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossMedium.stages.2.label: Moderate forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossMedium.stages.2.descripti: Another few-thousand hole. I keep the books now. Nobody ask.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossSmall.stages.0.label: Small forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossSmall.stages.0.descriptio: Lost a little on forex. Call it tuition.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossSmall.stages.1.label: Small forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossSmall.stages.1.descriptio: Another small loss. The tuition payments are getting frequent.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossSmall.stages.2.label: Small forex loss
LanguageData.RimForex_FxLossSmall.stages.2.descriptio: After several small losses, that tuition would cover an entire degree.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainSmall.stages.0.label: Small forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainSmall.stages.0.descriptio: Made a little on forex. Everyone gets an extra spoon of honey tonight.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainSmall.stages.1.label: Small forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainSmall.stages.1.descriptio: Another small win. The account is a bit fatter. A bit.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainSmall.stages.2.label: Small forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainSmall.stages.2.descriptio: Several small wins in a row. Enjoy it, but don't get cocky.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainMedium.stages.0.label: Moderate forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainMedium.stages.0.descripti: A few thousand made on forex. Enough to patch a wall, plus some herbal medicine.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainMedium.stages.1.label: Moderate forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainMedium.stages.1.descripti: Another thousand or so in. This one was actually earned.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainMedium.stages.2.label: Moderate forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainMedium.stages.2.descripti: Another few thousand up. Someone is asking what a sofa costs these days.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainBig.stages.0.label: Major forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainBig.stages.0.description: A big win — several thousand, near ten. This season can be lived with some dignity.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainBig.stages.1.label: Major forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainBig.stages.1.description: Another few thousand in. Someone proposed gold-plating the terminal. The project is on hold, but he is happy.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainBig.stages.2.label: Major forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainBig.stages.2.description: This trade made several thousand. The trader upgraded to a proper padded chair.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainHuge.stages.0.label: Huge forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainHuge.stages.0.description: A clean ten thousand on forex. The bookkeeper's fingers shook while counting it.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainHuge.stages.1.label: Huge forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainHuge.stages.1.description: Another ten thousand in. Someone suggested expanding the silver vault; it will not fit otherwise.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainHuge.stages.2.label: Huge forex gain
LanguageData.RimForex_FxGainHuge.stages.2.description: Another ten thousand. Now the worry is how to spend it — an easier problem than losing it.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxMarginCall.stages.0.label: Forex margin call
LanguageData.RimForex_FxMarginCall.stages.0.descripti: The margin blew. It was gone without a sound.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxMarginCall.stages.1.label: Forex margin call
LanguageData.RimForex_FxMarginCall.stages.1.descripti: Blown again — margin wiped to zero. The terminal looks factory-new. Our silver does not.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxMarginCall.stages.2.label: Forex margin call
LanguageData.RimForex_FxMarginCall.stages.2.descripti: Blown once more. The chair in front of the terminal is empty now, and people walk around it.
LanguageData.RimForex_FxBlowUp.stages.0.label: Forex negative equity
LanguageData.RimForex_FxBlowUp.stages.0.description: Negative equity: the margin is gone and the account balance has been pushed below zero. We now owe the trading platform money.
